description: Six labelled synthetic bug/safe pairs. Author-visible regression specimens, not an independent blind trial.

cases.title: Failed JSON becomes an empty feed
cases.oracle: Malformed response must yield an explicit unavailable state; not an empty successful feed.
cases.safeControl: A valid empty feed remains a legitimate success.

cases.title: Zero-row mutation claims success
cases.oracle: When one existing order must change, zero affected rows is a non-success result.
cases.safeControl: An explicitly permitted ensure-absent operation may succeed on zero changes.

cases.title: Duplicate webhook check-then-insert race
cases.oracle: At-most-once business effect per provider event ID under concurrently retried delivery.
cases.safeControl: Two different provider IDs are both accepted.

cases.title: Async callbacks ignored by completion
cases.oracle: A completed batch must have awaited all its required writes.
cases.safeControl: An intentionally queued job may return accepted before durable completion if documented.

cases.title: Stale client response overwrites current selection
cases.oracle: Only the response for the most recently selected tab may update current state.
cases.safeControl: An intentionally cached, timestamped older response is allowed if the contract says so.

cases.title: Unbounded Supabase read silently truncated
cases.oracle: Fetch every matching row using stable ordered pagination, not one default-capped request.
cases.safeControl: A bounded explicit first-N preview is valid under a first-N contract.
